scoring_justification: The checker sandbox cannot perform DFT calculations; therefore the checker compares the agent's reported valence band counts to the paper's reference values using exact match.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference valence band counts for AlIr, RuAl2, and RuGa3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Unified cluster-based description of valence bands in AlIr, RuAl2, RuGa3 and Al-TM quasicrystalline approximants' (DOI:10.1088/1742-6596/809/1/012014), Section 4: counting rule 5t+4c-b yields 6, 14, 34 and DFT confirms.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's published results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the paper's own reported numbers; they are the authoritative reference for the task.

outputs.description: Number of occupied valence bands (per primitive unit cell, without spin degeneracy) for AlIr, RuAl2, and RuGa3 computed from DFT eigenvalues.

output_contract.notes: The checker will read the three integer values and compare each to the paper-reported hidden gold using exact match with tolerance 0. If any value differs, reward is 0; if all match, reward is 1.

steps.description: Verify that the valence band counts match the paper's reference values.
